title: Timelock Puzzles
description: Encrypts a secret so decrypting requires a fixed amount of sequential computation - Rivest's time-lock puzzle. The delay is enforced by physics of computation, not by any party's promise.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Verifiable Delay Functions
description: Computes a delay that is fast to verify but slow to evaluate - VDFs prove a certain time has passed. Verification is cheap enough for blockchains to check on-chain.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Threshold Release
description: Splits the capsule key among trustees so release needs a quorum - any 3 of 5 - instead of one person's decision. Thresholds distribute the power to open secrets.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Sealed Bids
description: Holds auction bids sealed until the bidding closes, then opens them all at once for fair evaluation. Timelock-sealed bids need no trusted auctioneer.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dead-Man Switches
description: Releases the capsule if the owner stops checking in - the secret equivalent of a dead-man's brake. Switches protect whistleblowers and ensure continuity when someone cannot act.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Scheduled Disclosure
description: Publishes information at a predetermined time - embargoed news, timed announcements - enforced cryptographically. Disclosure happens on schedule even if the publisher disappears.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Puzzle Difficulty
description: Tunes timelock difficulty to the desired delay on reference hardware, with safety margins for faster machines. Difficulty tuning is what makes 'one month' actually mean one month.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Witness Encryption
description: Encrypts so decryption needs a witness - like a future blockchain state - rather than a key holder. Anyone who can present the witness decrypts; until then, nobody can.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Blockchain Anchoring
description: Anchors the capsule's commitment hash in a blockchain, timestamping its creation immutably. Anchoring proves the capsule existed at a time - nobody can backdate a sealed bid.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Capsule Formats
description: Defines interoperable capsule formats - headers, algorithms, parameters - so capsules created today open with tomorrow's tools. Formats are the difference between a time capsule and a time tomb.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Key Sharding
description: Splits capsule keys with Shamir's scheme across custodians and locations, requiring a threshold to reconstruct. Sharding survives lost shares and resists coerced ones.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Release Oracles
description: Uses oracle networks to attest that release conditions are met - the date arrived, the event occurred - triggering decryption. Oracles connect capsule logic to real-world facts.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Audit Trails
description: Logs capsule lifecycle events - creation, anchoring, access attempts, opening - in tamper-evident storage. Trails prove the capsule's integrity story to future openers.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Legal Holds
description: Places capsules under legal hold so scheduled release pauses during litigation, with the hold itself recorded. Holds reconcile timed disclosure with legal reality.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Recovery Procedures
description: Defines how lost trustees, corrupted shares, or failed puzzles are handled without breaking the time guarantee. Recovery procedures are the contingency plan every capsule needs.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
